briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multi-agent AGI benchmarks as compute wars intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier has accelerated with new model releases from OpenAI, Anthropic, and DeepSeek driving unprecedented investment and geopolitical focus. Multi-agent systems are emerging as the key battleground while regulatory pressure mounts on safety standards.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced reasoning chains; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; Google launched Gemini 3 Ultra; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B; xAI pushed Grok-3 beta; DeepSeek-V3 topped Chinese leaderboards. Multi-agent coordination benchmarks now define the cutting edge.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins next month with new red-team mandates.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 2M units monthly; Microsoft and Google each announced $50B+ data center expansions; TSMC 2nm yields improving for AI ASICs; Amazon and CoreWeave signed massive GPU leasing deals.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first superintelligent multi-agent system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese national project before 2028?
